stem: Sierra would like to add a sentence to bring her story to a more effective close. Which sentence could she add after sentence 42 to help achieve this goal?

options.label: F
options.text: As the son of Zeus and Diamond, Dudley was proud of his heritage.

options.label: G
options.text: The plain little colt had finally become the horse he had been bred to be.

options.label: H
options.text: He was ready to move back to the McGee ranch and be with his family again.

options.label: J
options.text: Dudley would never be the horse that people had hoped for, but he was still special.
